Hybrid search plus multi-query expansion for concept or landscape questions (expansion recovers synonym-phrased matches). Still top-K; return_unit returns whole sections or conversations. Lists: list_pages. Exact tokens: `search` is cheaper (no expansion LLM call). Personal: get_recent_salience, find_anomalies; transcripts: `gbrain transcripts recent` on the host. Do NOT assume 'crazy' means impressive (often difficult or emotionally charged). Needs an embedding key (else keyword-only); expansion needs a chat key. fields: "full" adds diagnostics.
--expand                   Default true; false skips the LLM expansion.
--detail                   low (compiled truth), medium (default) or high (all chunks).
--adaptive-return          true when one answer is wanted (fewer rows; never returns empty); omit for breadth.
--autocut                  Default on (never returns empty); false gives full top-K for breadth, unlike adaptive_return.
--explain-target           Expected page (slug or source:slug): why it is missing.

Create a typed link (edge) from one page to another in the same source. Use when recording a relationship (works_at, invested_in, mentions); remote page writes already link [[wikilinks]] to existing pages as mentions (receipt auto_links), so add only typed links or ones the text lacks. Needs write scope; an explicit link_type must be declared by the active schema pack. On page_not_found: resolve both slugs with resolve_slugs.

<from>                     Slug of the page the link originates from (the edge renders on this page), e.g. 'people/alice-example'. These are page slugs — there is no `source`/`target` pair. (required)
<to>                       Slug of the page the link points to, e.g. 'companies/acme-example'. (required)

--link-type                Link type (e.g., invested_in, works_at). When the active schema pack declares a link vocabulary, an explicit link_type must be one of its declared verbs (undeclared verbs are rejected, also under dry_run). Omitted = untyped edge.
--link-source              Provenance tag (kebab-case, e.g. 'citation-graph'). Defaults to 'manual'. Reconciliation-managed built-ins (markdown/frontmatter/mentions/wikilink-resolved) are rejected.
--valid-from               When the relationship started (YYYY-MM-DD), for dated relations such as works_at or invested_in.
--valid-until              When it ended (YYYY-MM-DD, exclusive). Re-run add_link with valid_until to record that a relationship ended.
